scope: Keep the signed 32-bit group-90 identifier domain distinct from the bounded binary-payload-size domain for DXF EXTRUDEDSURFACE and SWEPTSURFACE records.

finding.before: The EXTRUDEDSURFACE class-ID and SWEPTSURFACE sweep/path-ID parser branches rejected values above DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes (64 MiB), even though the same group-90 slots identify objects/records and the corresponding writer accepts nonnegative signed-32-bit values. REVOLVEDSURFACE already applied the size cap only to its declared payload-size slot.

authority.title: Autodesk Extruded Surface (DXF)
authority.relevantFields: Group 90 is Class ID, then group 90 is binary-data size, followed by group 310 binary data.

authority.title: Autodesk Revolved Surface (DXF)
authority.relevantFields: Group 90 is revolve-entity ID, then group 90 is binary-data size, followed by group 310 binary data.

authority.title: Autodesk Swept Surface (DXF)
authority.relevantFields: Group 90 identifies the sweep entity and path entity as well as the two binary-data sizes; group 310 carries the payloads.

authority.title: Autodesk Group Code Value Types Reference (DXF)

finding.codeCrossCheck: The public DXF writer rejects identifiers only above INT32_MAX and independently bounds each binary payload by DRW::kMaxDxfBinaryPayloadBytes.

implementation.change: EXTRUDEDSURFACE classId and SWEPTSURFACE sweepEntityId/pathEntityId now accept nonnegative group-90 signed-32-bit values. Their declared payload-size slots retain the 64 MiB cap; REVOLVEDSURFACE remains unchanged.

coverage: ASCII and Binary EXTRUDEDSURFACE accept classId = 64 MiB + 1.
ASCII and Binary REVOLVEDSURFACE provide a neighboring full-ID-domain control.
ASCII and Binary SWEPTSURFACE accept sweep and path IDs above 64 MiB.
ASCII and Binary EXTRUDEDSURFACE reject a declared payload size above 64 MiB.
ASCII and Binary SWEPTSURFACE reject oversized sweep-data and path-data lengths while applying the same 64 MiB cap.
generatedControls.provenance: DXF group streams are generated in memory by the existing test helper; no external drawing or repository fixture was added.

limitations: This is a DXF parser correctness fix and does not qualify any DWG source profile, ACIS geometry, or native 3D consumer behavior.
No package gate or support claim is promoted.
